label: GitHub
description: GitHub tokens: classic and fine-grained personal access tokens, OAuth, app, and refresh tokens.

signals.reason: A classic personal access token (ghp_) acts on every repository that the account can reach, with the scopes of the token.
A fine-grained token (github_pat_) acts only on the repositories and permissions that the owner selected.
An OAuth token (gho_) acts for the user on every repository that the user can reach, with the scopes of the app.
A user-to-server token (ghu_) acts for a user with the permissions of a GitHub App.
An installation token (ghs_) expires after one hour. It has the permissions of the app installation.
A refresh token (ghr_) gets new user-to-server tokens for a GitHub App.
The variable name is the GitHub CLI token variable.
The item name or a label names GitHub.
A host of the item is a GitHub host.
